title: Research organisation requests unrestricted intelligence access
explanation: Access denied because ACM, BELL_LAPADULA, CONTEXT did not permit the read request.
impact: Unrestricted release would expose suspect identifiers and threat reporting in intelligence.json. The matrix has no research role, and the purpose is not OPERATIONS.

title: Emergency responders request classified national-security information
explanation: Access denied because ACM, BELL_LAPADULA did not permit the read request.
impact: Police clearance is OPERATIONAL and the matrix does not grant intelligence:read. Granting it would collapse the boundary between response data and restricted intelligence.

title: A regional datacentre becomes permanently unavailable
explanation: The three logical regions share one teaching process. Isolating every Raft node removes the majority required to commit a new incident status. The earlier committed value is not rewritten.
log: Control: all three nodes can communicate.
R1 increments to term 1 and votes for itself.
R2 grants its vote to R1 in term 1.
R3 grants its vote to R1 in term 1.
R1 becomes leader with 3 of 3 votes (quorum 2).
R1 appends 'incident-status-verified' at index 1 in term 1.
R2 stores 'incident-status-verified'.
R3 stores 'incident-status-verified'.
Committed 'incident-status-verified' at index 1 with 3 of 3 copies.
Fault: each node is placed in its own partition, so no side holds a majority of the three-node membership.
R1 appends 'incident-status-closed' at index 2 in term 1.
R2 does not acknowledge the entry.
R3 does not acknowledge the entry.
Not committed: 1 copy(ies), quorum is 2.

title: Validator credentials protecting the national audit system are compromised
explanation: Revocation rejects the old authenticator. A replacement version can authenticate later votes. HMAC here is a shared-key teaching substitute, not a public-key signature.
log: V4 is registered at key version 1 and can authenticate a vote.
Version 1 signature before revocation: Authenticated.
Authorised revocation sets V4 to REVOKED.
Same signature after revocation: Unknown, disabled or revoked validator.
A replacement key is registered as version 2.
Version 2 signature: Authenticated.
Version 1 signature after rotation: Outdated key version.

title: Regulations require emergency-response records to be retained for twenty years

within_period.reason: Record remains within its classification retention period.

at_expiry.reason: Retention period has elapsed and no legal hold is set. Derived copies may be destroyed; source coursework files are left unchanged.

legal_hold.reason: Legal hold prevents deletion regardless of expiry.

explanation: RESTRICTED uses 20 years. PUBLIC, OPERATIONAL and SENSITIVE keep shorter demonstration periods. A legal hold blocks destruction. Original files in data/source are not deleted.
